    {:ok, %{
      jobs: %{},

    }}
  end

  def handle_info(:process_queue, state) do
    if state.active_workers < state.max_workers and not :queue.is_empty(state.job_queue) do
      {{:value, {job_id, job_type, params}}, new_queue} = :queue.out(state.job_queue)
      
      task = Task.async(fn ->
        execute_julia_job(job_id, job_type, params)
      end)
      
      new_jobs = Map.put(state.jobs, job_id, %{
        task: task,
        type: job_type,
        params: params,
        status: :processing,
        created_at: DateTime.utc_now()
      })
      
      {:noreply, %{state | 
        jobs: new_jobs, 
        job_queue: new_queue,
        active_workers: state.active_workers + 1
      }}
    else
      {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:job_completed, job_id, result}, state) do
    new_jobs = Map.update(state.jobs, job_id, %{}, fn job ->
      %{job | status: :completed, result: result, completed_at: DateTime.utc_now()}
    end)
    
    {:noreply, %{state | jobs: new_jobs}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({ref, result}, state) when is_reference(ref) do
    case find_job_by_task_ref(state.jobs, ref) do
      {job_id, _job} ->
        new_jobs = Map.update!(state.jobs, job_id, fn job ->
          Map.merge(job, %{status: :completed, result: result, completed_at: DateTime.utc_now()})
        end)
        {:noreply, %{state | jobs: new_jobs, active_workers: max(0, state.active_workers - 1)}}
      
      nil ->
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:DOWN, ref, :process, _pid, reason}, state) do
    case find_job_by_task_ref(state.jobs, ref) do
      {job_id, _job} ->
        Logger.error("Task failed for job #{job_id}: #{inspect(reason)}")
        new_jobs = Map.update!(state.jobs, job_id, fn job ->
          Map.merge(job, %{status: :failed, error: inspect(reason), completed_at: DateTime.utc_now()})
        end)
        {:noreply, %{state | jobs: new_jobs, active_workers: max(0, state.active_workers - 1)}}
      
      nil ->
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

    case Map.get(state.jobs, job_id) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}
      
      job ->
        case Task.yield(job.task, 0) do
          {:ok, result} ->
            new_jobs = Map.update!(state.jobs, job_id, fn j ->

            end)
            {:reply, {:ok, %{status: :completed, result: result}}, %{state | jobs: new_jobs, active_workers: max(0, state.active_workers - 1)}}

            end)
            {:reply, {:ok, %{status: :failed, error: inspect(reason)}}, %{state | jobs: new_jobs, active_workers: max(0, state.active_workers - 1)}}
        end
    end

defmodule AlphaFoldServer.WebSocketHandler do
  @behaviour WebSock
  require Logger

  def init(_opts) do
    Logger.info("WebSocket connection established with client")
    initial_state = %{
      connected_at: DateTime.utc_now(),
      message_count: 0,
      subscriptions: []
    }
    {:ok, initial_state}
  end

  def handle_in({message, opcode: :text}, state) do
    case Jason.decode(message) do
      {:ok, payload} ->
        handle_message(payload, state)
      
      {:error, _} ->
        error_response = Jason.encode!(%{error: "Invalid JSON"})
        {:reply, :ok, {:text, error_response}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_in(_frame, state) do
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def handle_info({:job_complete, job_id, result}, state) do
    response = Jason.encode!(%{
      type: "job_complete",
      job_id: job_id,
      result: result
    })
    
    {:push, {:text, response}, state}
  end

  def handle_info(_info, state) do
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def terminate(_reason, _state) do
    :ok
  end

  defp handle_message(%{"type" => "submit_job", "job_type" => job_type, "params" => params}, state) do
    case AlphaFoldServer.JobCoordinator.submit_job(job_type, params) do
      {:ok, job_id} ->
        response = Jason.encode!(%{
          type: "job_submitted",
          job_id: job_id,
          status: "processing"
        })
        
        {:reply, :ok, {:text, response}, state}
      
      {:error, reason} ->
        error_response = Jason.encode!(%{
          type: "error",
          error: inspect(reason)
        })
        
        {:reply, :ok, {:text, error_response}, state}
    end
  end

  defp handle_message(%{"type" => "get_job_status", "job_id" => job_id}, state) do
    case AlphaFoldServer.JobCoordinator.get_job_status(job_id) do
      {:ok, status} ->
        response = Jason.encode!(%{
          type: "job_status",
          job_id: job_id,
          status: status
        })
        
        {:reply, :ok, {:text, response}, state}
      
      {:error, :not_found} ->
        error_response = Jason.encode!(%{
          type: "error",
          error: "Job not found"
        })
        
        {:reply, :ok, {:text, error_response}, state}
    end
  end

  defp handle_message(%{"type" => "ping"}, state) do
    response = Jason.encode!(%{type: "pong", timestamp: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()})
    {:reply, :ok, {:text, response}, state}
  end

  defp handle_message(_, state) do
    error_response = Jason.encode!(%{error: "Unknown message type"})
    {:reply, :ok, {:text, error_response}, state}
  end
end

defmodule AlphaFoldServer.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug CORSPlug, origin: "*"
  plug Plug.Logger
  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json], json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  get "/" do
    send_file(conn, 200, "public/index.html")
  end

  get "/ws" do
    conn
    |> WebSockAdapter.upgrade(AlphaFoldServer.WebSocketHandler, %{}, 
         timeout: 60_000,
         compress: false,
         max_frame_size: 1_000_000)
    |> halt()
    |> halt()
  end

  post "/api/jobs" do
    job_type = conn.body_params["job_type"]
    params = conn.body_params["params"]
    
    case AlphaFoldServer.JobCoordinator.submit_job(job_type, params) do
      {:ok, job_id} ->
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
        |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{success: true, job_id: job_id}))
      
      {:error, reason} ->
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
        |> send_resp(500, Jason.encode!(%{success: false, error: inspect(reason)}))
    end
  end

  get "/api/jobs/:job_id" do
    job_id = conn.path_params["job_id"]
    
    case AlphaFoldServer.JobCoordinator.get_job_status(job_id) do
      {:ok, status} ->
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
        |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(status))
      
      {:error, :not_found} ->
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
        |> send_resp(404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Job not found"}))
    end
  end

  get "/api/health" do
    case AlphaFoldServer.JobCoordinator.health_check() do
      {:ok, health} ->
